codec.title: Native multimode codecs (experimental)
codec.virtualOnly: Offline codec capabilities only, not an operational radio-mode selector.
codec.noRf: Physical RF transmit remains disabled in this experimental implementation until P9 acceptance.
codec.failed: Simulation failed: inspect native module and server diagnostics
codec.simNote: Uses seeded AWGN and synthetic receiver PCM for functional testing only; not an RF or sensitivity acceptance test.
codec.liveSubtitle: Decoding in the existing radio workspace with the shared mode selector and spectrum.
codec.liveNoTx: This workbench supports live AF reception, guarded manual RF transmission and operator-confirmed QSOs. RF TX remains locked unless explicitly authorized; reception never keys PTT.
codec.liveInvalidFrequency: Enter AF frequency between 100 and 5500 Hz
codec.rfAvailable: Experimental RF enabled; coordinated through physical TX lease
codec.rfLocked: RF TX is locked pending P9 safety acceptance
codec.beaconAuthorization: I explicitly authorize a WSPR beacon transmission (120 s period)
codec.txFailed: Transmission failed: check mode, operator permissions and radio connection
codec.autoPending: AUTO TX is waiting for its UTC slot; PTT is not yet confirmed.
codec.autoConfirmed: The last automatic transmission completed with host-confirmed PCM/PTT.
codec.autoNeedsStart: Switching on operator TX does not start native RF: select AUTO TX here for Q65, MSK144 or WSPR.
codec.logManualOnly: Confirm only after a genuine two-way exchange. A decode alone is not proof of a completed QSO. WSPR beacons are not QSOs.
codec.logSaved: Contact saved in the existing logbook
codec.logFailed: Logbook write failed: inspect operator, mode and logbook
codec.logFrequencyInvalid: Enter a valid RF frequency in MHz
codec.apGuide: AP hypotheses are enabled only with valid station call, station grid and DX call. Apply receiver settings to restart decoding.
codec.wsprLocalOnly: Standard decoded messages only. AF Hz is not the RF dial frequency. Nothing is auto-uploaded to WSPRnet or PSK Reporter.
codec.wsprNoSpots: No recognized standard WSPR messages yet.
codec.mskFixedTxAf: MSK144 transmit audio is fixed at 1500 Hz (WSJT-X standard); RX AF centre can differ. Message format: CALL1 CALL2 REPORT.
codec.armAcknowledgement: I confirm that the selected station is permitted to transmit on this frequency and that the RF, antenna and PTT paths are ready. Arm this current radio session for up to 10 minutes.
codec.armFailed: RF authorization failed; confirm real radio connection, running receiver and permissions.
codec.selectDecode: Double-click a decoded station to use its CQ callsign and AF frequency in the operator pane (no automatic TX).
codec.apApply: Apply AP to live Q65 RX
codec.apUpdated: AP updated without interrupting Q65 averaging
codec.apUpdateFailed: AP update failed; check callsign/grid and receiver status
